records.verbatim: En Pampa Energía ya contamos con 800 MW de generación eléctrica disponibles para un centro de datos en Vaca Muerta.

translation.text: At Pampa Energía we already have 800 MW of electricity generation available for a data center in Vaca Muerta.

records.notes: First-party: named chairman, direct quote. The article says the 780 MW Loma La Lata thermal plant matches the figure, but Pampa did not say which plant would supply it. A GlobalPorts summary (not fetched) says no new generation would be built and that the first modules would be 20-40 MW; treat as unverified. fields.source_title: Chequeado, A un año del anuncio de OpenAI y el Gobierno, no hay avances (15 Oct 2026)

records.verbatim: A un año del anuncio, no se registraron avances ni inversiones concretas y tampoco se presentó formalmente la adhesión del proyecto al RIGI.

translation.text: A year after the announcement, no progress or concrete investment has been recorded, and the project has not formally applied to join the RIGI.

records.notes: Journalist status check, not a company statement. Also on the page (quoted): the Ministry of Economy said there had been 'ningún movimiento' on a possible RIGI filing, and Sur Energy's newsroom's last item is dated 10 Oct 2025 (Chequeado text; Sur Energy did not reply). Chequeado describes the project as eligible for the Super RIGI, which is still in the Senate. Use as the status line for ar-stargate-argentina; do not treat as a community response.

fields.source_title: Noticias Argentinas (NA) via elDiarioAR, Súper RIGI Senate changes (2 Sep 2026)

records.verbatim: La primera obliga a las empresas que instalen centros de datos a construir sus propias subestaciones eléctricas

translation.text: The first requires companies installing data centers to build their own electrical substations.

records.notes: Update to ar-super-rigi-2026, not a new instrument. The second change adds a local-supplier plan with a national procurement commitment of at least 20% of the investment (same article). Chequeado (verified) confirms the bill is still in the Senate after Diputados' half-approval. The Diputados vote figure (130-106-7, 24 Jun 2026) comes from a search summary and is not verified on the page. Senate passage was not confirmed in any source found; re-check before treating status as current.

fields.source_title: BioBioChile, SEA resuelve que Google no debe pasar por evaluación ambiental para construir data center en Cerrillos (19 Oct 2026)

records.verbatim: resolvió que el futuro data center de Google en Cerrillos no requerirá pasar por el Sistema de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental (SEIA)

translation.text: resolved that Google's future data center in Cerrillos will not need to go through the Environmental Impact Assessment System (SEIA)

records.notes: SEA Región Metropolitana ruling after a redesign. BioBio reports that the Segundo Tribunal Ambiental partly annulled the Feb 2020 approval in Feb 2024, after neighbours' and organizations' challenges, and Google withdrew that authorization in July 2024 and refiled with air cooling. The article says the ruling is not a final construction permit and other permits are still needed. Sources disagree on what precedent the SEA followed (a Substack says 24 July 2026); unverified. Record as a regulator decision, not a permit.

fields.source_title: Radio Universidad de Chile, El agua que usa la IA es chilena: vecinos de Quilicura alegan 'falta de responsabilidad' de data centers (4 Mar 2026)

records.verbatim: tiene registrado un derecho a aprovechamiento de agua desde las napas subterráneas, que alimentan el humedal de Quilicura, de 50 litros por segundo

translation.text: has a registered right to use water from the underground aquifers, which feed the Quilicura wetland, of 50 litres per second

records.notes: Quoted from a spokesperson of Resistencia Socioambiental Quilicura (RSQ); the individual is not named here. The same article carries Google's own 2024 figure (verified): 'el 2024 su centro de datos utilizó un total de 458 millones de litros de agua'. The water-right figure is the community's reading of Google's filing (the Declaración de Impacto Ambiental was not fetched). Both sides belong on the record. The existing cl-claim-google-quilicura-water (121.8 million gallons) matches the same 2024 figure.

leads.item: Plan Nacional de Data Centers: comité multiactor and '9 medidas con avances significativos'
leads.notes: The DCD Spanish page returned 403; the figure is from a search summary. The plan PDF (minciencia.gob.cl) and the committee actas are the primary sources. A formal progress report was not found. Re-try the DCD page or the MinCiencia news page.

Search could not link the project to a company. Pull the titular from the SEA pertinencia file (pertinencia.sea.gob.cl, July 2026 filing). Do not guess from other Lampa filings (DC Terranova SPA / GR Huiña SPA relate to Alto Jahuel per the search).

leads.item: Seven or more projects filing pertinencia to avoid SEIA (SEA as venue)
leads.notes: Several 2026 reports (El Clarín, electromineria.cl, Terram) list the pattern: Cerrillos, Lampa, Puente Alto, Buin, Valparaíso. Each needs its own SEA file before a record; treat the list as a worklist.

leads.item: Neuquén provincial action on data centres
leads.notes: Searches found Governor Figueroa's general investment promotion and the Pampa offer, but no provincial law or regulation for data centres. Check the Legislatura de Neuquén and the provincial Boletín Oficial directly.
